parameters.name: TotalQueries
parameters.description: The total number of DNS queries received.

parameters.name: CacheHits
parameters.description: The number of DNS queries that were successfully answered using the DNS cache, without contacting an external DNS server.

parameters.name: CacheMisses
parameters.description: The number of DNS queries that could not be answered using the DNS cache and thus required contacting an external DNS server.

parameters.name: RecursiveReplies
parameters.description: The total number of replies received from recursive DNS queries, where the relay queried other DNS servers to resolve the query.

parameters.name: RequestListAvg
parameters.description: The average number of requests being processed in the relay's request list at any given time.

parameters.name: RequestListMax
parameters.description: The maximum number of requests that were ever in the request list at once.

parameters.name: RequestListOverwritten
parameters.description: The number of times an entry in the request list was overwritten before it could be processed.

parameters.name: RequestListExceeded
parameters.description: The number of times the request list capacity was exceeded, and additional requests were dropped.

parameters.name: RequestListCurrentAll
parameters.description: The current number of requests in the relay's request list.

parameters.name: RequestListCurrentUser
parameters.description: The current number of outstanding DNS requests in the relay's request list that originated from LAN/client-facing interfaces (i.e., requests received from subscriber devices), excluding requests initiated internally by the DNS relay/resolver itself (e.g., cache prefetch/refresh, health checks, or other maintenance queries generated by the platform).

parameters.name: QueryTypeA
parameters.description: The number of DNS queries requesting an A record (IPv4 address).

parameters.name: QueryTypePTR
parameters.description: The number of DNS queries requesting a PTR record (Pointer, typically used for reverse DNS lookups).

parameters.name: QueryTypeTXT
parameters.description: The number of DNS queries requesting a TXT record (text information).

parameters.name: QueryTypeAAAA
parameters.description: The number of DNS queries requesting an AAAA record (IPv6 address).

parameters.name: QueryTypeSRV
parameters.description: The number of DNS queries requesting an SRV record (service location).

parameters.name: QueryTypeANY
parameters.description: The number of DNS queries requesting any type of record.

parameters.name: QueryClassIN
parameters.description: The number of DNS queries in the IN (Internet) class.

parameters.name: OpcodeQUERY
parameters.description: The number of standard DNS queries (opcode QUERY).

parameters.name: QueryTCP
parameters.description: The number of DNS queries received over TCP.

parameters.name: QueryIPv6
parameters.description: The number of DNS queries received over IPv6.

parameters.name: QueryFlagsQR
parameters.description: The number of DNS queries with the QR (Query/Response) flag set, indicating a response.

parameters.name: QueryFlagsAA
parameters.description: The number of DNS queries with the AA (Authoritative Answer) flag set, indicating the response is authoritative.

parameters.name: QueryFlagsTC
parameters.description: The number of DNS queries with the TC (Truncated) flag set, indicating the response is truncated and the client should retry over TCP.

parameters.name: QueryFlagsRD
parameters.description: The number of DNS queries with the RD (Recursion Desired) flag set, requesting recursive resolution.

parameters.name: QueryFlagsRA
parameters.description: The number of DNS queries with the RA (Recursion Available) flag set, indicating the server supports recursive queries.

parameters.name: QueryFlagsAD
parameters.description: The number of DNS queries with the AD (Authenticated Data) flag set, indicating the data has been authenticated.

parameters.name: QueryFlagsCD
parameters.description: The number of DNS queries with the CD (Checking Disabled) flag set, indicating the client does not want DNSSEC validation.

parameters.name: QueryEDNSPresent
parameters.description: The number of DNS queries using EDNS (Extension Mechanisms for DNS).

parameters.name: AnswerRCodeNOERROR
parameters.description: The number of DNS responses with the NOERROR response code, indicating no error.

parameters.name: AnswerRCodeSERVFAIL
parameters.description: The number of DNS responses with the SERVFAIL response code, indicating a server failure.

parameters.name: AnswerRCodeNXDOMAIN
parameters.description: The number of DNS responses with the NXDOMAIN response code, indicating the domain name does not exist.

parameters.name: AnswerRCodeNoData
parameters.description: The number of DNS responses with the NOERROR response code, but also no data.

parameters.name: UnwantedQueries
parameters.description: The number of DNS queries that were unwanted or unsolicited.

parameters.name: UnwantedReplies
parameters.description: The number of DNS replies that were unwanted or unsolicited.

object.description: DNS statistics for this DNS proxy (or relay).
